# CRM Industry Definition & Boundary

| Topic | Definition |
| --- | --- |
| Included | Software and services that manage accounts, contacts, leads, opportunities, activities, quotations, orders, collections, service interactions and revenue analytics across the customer lifecycle. |
| Adjacent systems | Marketing automation, CPQ, ERP, finance, customer service, communication and collaboration tools may connect to CRM but are not automatically part of the CRM market. |
| Excluded from market comparison | A contact list, single-channel advertising tool, standalone email client or an internal spreadsheet is not a complete CRM system. |
| System boundary | Actual integrations, fields, permissions, deployment and local compliance depend on the organisation, jurisdiction and selected system scope. |
| Geography | The supplied evidence covers Mainland China, ASEAN/Singapore, the United States and the European Union. Each jurisdiction retains its own marketing and data rules. |
